featured_reviews.name: Mushtaque Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Company had booked the space for 1 month, but we had to move out within 1 week as we had an extremely disappointing experience at this co-working space. The infrastructure is in terrible condition — the building itself is dilapidated and unsafe as it has been flagged by the municipal authorities. During the monsoon, the situation becomes unbearable with constant leakages from ceilings and AC units inside office and flooding outside the office

The washroom facilities are frankly unacceptable. There are no basic amenities like tissues, the jet sprays don’t work, and cleanliness is severely lacking. Despite repeated complaints, there seems to be no responsible staff or management willing to take ownership or resolve issues.

Parking is another major headache, and the approach road is in poor condition, making daily access frustrating. The premises are also overcrowded with e-commerce delivery traffic, which adds to the chaos.

The cafeteria area is no better — it frequently experiences water flooding, and there is a persistent sewage stench that makes it unpleasant to even sit there. On top of that, pest control is clearly neglected, adding to the unhygienic environment.

Overall, this space falls far below even basic standards for a professional work environment. I would strongly advise others to reconsider before choosing this location.

Please don’t judge me by my account name
,  I’m a real person sharing a genuine experience.

WeWork Raheja Platinum is honestly one of the best places to work. For me, it felt like a healing space, full of positivity, and the perfect environment to start work every day.

One incident really earned my respect for them:
I once forgot my small Nokia phone there. For an entire week, I didn’t even realize it was missing until I checked my bag and couldn’t find it. I searched everywhere at home but no luck. Finally, I asked the WeWork security team if they had found any phone matching my description. They asked for details about the day and place I last saw it — and to my surprise, they actually had my phone safe with them! They returned it to me without hesitation. That moment made me trust them blindly, because in many other offices, things like this just get lost, and sometimes even the CCTV doesn’t work properly. But here, the staff were so honest and professional.

Another time, I was feeling very sleepy on the 9th floor and dozed off on a chair in a weird position. The staff came quietly just to check if I was okay — without disturbing me. That showed how much they care for people’s well-being, not just their work.

I left WeWork some time back, but I know I’ll return someday — even if it’s just with a day pass. And I can’t forget to mention the beautiful, warm community team 🥹😍 — they truly made the place feel like home.

💙 Love you all guys 🫂
